title: PENASARAN BOBOT SEPEDA + TEST NANJAK 20%++ PARDUS SUPER SPORTS DISC

takeaways.text: On climbs of 15–20% the endurance-leaning geometry felt light and easy, though the stock 11–28 cassette was hard work; vibration damping and rolling feel were good.
With the stock build plus pedals, mounts and bottle cages it weighed 9.5 kg on a luggage scale; he notes everything except the frame is alloy and the bike cost around Rp 20 million.

disclosure: Owner-style ride and weigh-in video; no sponsorship is stated. Indonesian automatic captions.
summary: An Indonesian rider's climbing test and weigh-in of an original-generation PARDUS Super Sport disc with Shimano 105.
